user.title: ChatGPT OAuth
user.description: Choose the model and default behavior for this ChatGPT account. Authentication is completed in the next steps.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this account in Home Assistant.
data_description.model: The model used by Assist and AI Task actions.
data_description.enable_home_assistant_control: Allow the Assist conversation agent to inspect and control entities exposed to Assist. Disable this for conversation-only use.
data_description.web_search_mode: Disabled never exposes web search. Automatic lets the model search when useful. Required must return a web-search call or citation before the answer is accepted.
data_description.web_search_context_size: Low is best for simple lookups, Medium is balanced, and High provides more result context for detailed answers.
data_description.web_search_include_sources: When enabled, searched answers include clickable citations and a Sources section. Leave disabled for natural voice responses; Assist still exposes the cited answer in a separate card, and integration actions still return citation metadata.
data_description.web_search_live_access: Allow OpenAI to fetch live pages. Disable this to use only cached or indexed search content when supported.
data_description.web_search_use_home_assistant_location: Send Home Assistant's country and time zone as an approximate search hint. Latitude, longitude, street address, and zone coordinates are never sent.
data_description.prompt: Default instructions used by the Assist agent and integration actions.

reasoning.title: Thinking level
reasoning.description: Choose a thinking level available for **{model}**. Higher levels can improve difficult tasks but may respond more slowly. Ultra uses Max model reasoning because Codex subagent delegation is not available inside Home Assistant.

auth_manual.title: Sign in to ChatGPT
auth_manual.description:
1. Open [the ChatGPT sign-in page]({authorize_url}).
2. Complete sign-in in your browser.
3. The browser will finish on a localhost page that may show a connection error. Copy the **entire URL** from the address bar.
4. Paste that URL below.

The callback URL contains a short-lived authorization code. Do not share it.

data_description.callback_url: Paste the complete localhost callback URL from the browser address bar.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the ChatGPT service. Check the Home Assistant network connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: ChatGPT rejected the sign-in or credentials. Start the sign-in step again.
error.invalid_response: ChatGPT returned an unsupported response during setup.
error.missing_code: Paste the complete callback URL or an authorization code.
error.rate_limited: The signed-in ChatGPT account is currently rate limited. Try again after its usage limit resets.
error.state_mismatch: The callback belongs to a different setup attempt. Restart setup and use the newly generated sign-in link.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while setting up ChatGPT OAuth.
error.unsupported_model: Select one of the models shown in the list.
